t: Complete fixing set for quick, simple mounting of free-standing toilets and bidets with lateral, or side-fixing holes. Mounting bracket, with pre-drilled holes, enables flexible fixing in both directions and compensates for height differences in ceramics. Expansion plugs, mounting brackets, flush sleeves and cover caps made from high-strength, ageing-resistant nylon material.
b: Contents: Nylon Plugs (2), Zinc-Plated Hex Screws 7 x 60mm (2), Countersunk Nylon Bushes (2), A2 Pozidriv Stainless Steel Countersunk Screws 5 x 45mm (2), Nylon Angle Brackets (2) & Flat White Caps (2
For WC/Bidet with Lateral or Side-Fixing Holes
For Fixing Into Wooden & Concrete Floors
